title: Quote Request Assistant
businessOutcomes: Quote requests are answered faster and nothing gets lost.
summary: Capture quote requests from forms and emails, extract requirements, and draft initial quote responses or scope documents.
businessProblem: Quote requests arrive via website forms, email, and phone messages in inconsistent formats. Staff spend 20–30 minutes per request just organizing requirements before they can price anything.
outcome: Each quote request is automatically logged, requirements extracted into a structured format, and a draft scope/acknowledgment email sent within 1 hour of receipt.
expectedOutcomes: Each quote request is automatically logged, requirements extracted into a structured format, and a draft scope/acknowledgment email sent within 1 hour of receipt.
whoItsFor: Businesses receiving 5–30 quote requests per week where each quote requires understanding scope before pricing — contractors, agencies, custom manufacturers.
aiInputs: Raw quote request (form fields or email body)
Past quote examples for similar requests
Qualification criteria (minimum project size, service area, etc.)
aiOutputs: Structured requirements summary: scope, timeline, budget signals, location
Qualification score: fit vs. not-fit with reasons
Draft acknowledgment email with clarifying questions
New row in quote tracker spreadsheet/CRM
noCodeTools: Zapier: form submit → ChatGPT extract → Sheets row + Gmail draft
lowCodeTools: n8n: form webhook → OpenAI structured extraction → CRM + email
Make.com with form parser and GPT modules
customBuildStack: Webhook for form submissions + Gmail label trigger for email quotes
OpenAI structured JSON output for requirement extraction
implementationSteps: Define quote tracker columns and qualification criteria
Connect form and email intake channels
Build extraction prompt with 5–10 past quote examples
Set up auto-acknowledgment draft with clarifying questions
Run in review mode: AI extracts and logs, human reviews before sending
Track quote-to-close rate and refine qualification criteria quarterly
systemBehavior: Triggered on each new form submission or labeled email
Extracts and structures requirements — does not generate final pricing
Flags unqualified requests with reason (out of area, too small, etc.)
Creates tracker row and acknowledgment draft within 1 hour
Escalates complex or high-value requests to owner immediately
risks: AI may miss critical requirements leading to under-quoted projects
Auto-acknowledgment with wrong clarifying questions looks unprofessional
Qualification AI may reject good leads with non-standard requests
Pricing guidelines in prompts could leak through draft emails
